mapper.select: select mc.id, mc.coupon_id, mc.member_id, mc.status, mc.expires_at, mc.order_no, mc.used_time, mc.create_time, c.name as coupon_name, c.type, c.discount_amount, c.discount_percent, c.max_discount_amount, c.min_order_amount, c.is_first_order_only from mall_member_coupon mc inner join mall_coupon c on c.coupon_id = mc.coupon_id where mc.member_id = #{memberId} order by mc.status asc, mc.expires_at asc

select mc.id, mc.coupon_id, mc.member_id, mc.status, mc.expires_at, mc.order_no, mc.used_time, mc.create_time, c.name as coupon_name, c.type, c.discount_amount, c.discount_percent, c.max_discount_amount, c.min_order_amount, c.is_first_order_only from mall_member_coupon mc inner join mall_coupon c on c.coupon_id = mc.coupon_id where mc.id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into mall_member_coupon(coupon_id, member_id, status, expires_at, create_time) values(#{couponId}, #{memberId}, 0, #{expiresAt}, now())
mapper.update: update mall_member_coupon set status = 2 where status = 0 and expires_at < now()
